description: CREATES a new playlist and ADDS the given tracks in one shot. Every creation is confirmed by the user. Show the list with per-track justification in chat first.
name: create_playlist

description: Adds tracks to an existing playlist. Mutation confirmed by the user.
name: add_tracks

description: Removes tracks from a playlist. Mutation confirmed by the user.
name: remove_tracks

description: Updates a playlist's name and/or description. Mutation confirmed by the user.
name: set_playlist_details

description: Replaces ALL tracks of a playlist with the given list (used for undo and hygiene). Mutation confirmed by the user.
name: replace_playlist_tracks

description: Changes a playlist's cover (JPEG image in base64, max 256KB). Mutation confirmed by the user.
name: set_playlist_cover

description: Your recently played tracks from the client's history (RecentsAPI). Returns up to `limit` items with track name, artists, album, URI, `added_at`, `fully_played`, `resume_position_ms`. Use instead of the rate-limited `get_top_tracks`/`get_top_artists` to understand what you actually listened to recently.
name: get_listening_recents

time_range.description: short_term, medium_term, long_term (ignored; history is unbounded)

description: What is playing RIGHT NOW in the Spotify client (track, artists, album, is_playing, progress, context). Use this FIRST whenever the user says 'this song', 'what is playing', 'a música que está tocando', or refers to the current track. Returns null when nothing is playing.
name: get_currently_playing

description: Full playback state of the Spotify client: is_playing, progress/duration, volume, muted, shuffle, repeat, speed, sleep timer, playback quality, context URI, index, restrictions, plus the current track. Use when the user wants the full picture of what the player is doing.
name: get_player_state

description: The client playback queue: the current item, what is next up, and manually queued items. Use when the user asks what is coming next or reasons about the queue.
name: get_player_queue

description: Spotify Connect devices visible to the client (name, type, active state, volume). Use when the user asks where the music is playing or wants to move playback.
name: get_connect_devices

description: Controls playback in the client. action is one of: play, pause, toggle, next, previous, seek (needs position_ms), shuffle (needs shuffle: boolean), repeat (needs repeat: 0 off | 1 context | 2 track), volume (needs volume: 0..1), mute (needs mute: boolean), speed (needs speed: number), sleep_timer (needs minutes, null clears). Transient and instantly reversible. Only call it when the user actually asks to control playback.
name: player_control

description: Manipulates the playback queue. action is one of: add (needs uri), insert_next (needs uri), remove (needs index), reorder (needs from and to), clear. Transient and reversible.
name: player_queue_control

description: Lists the user's playlists. Returns {source, total, playlists[]} with id/uri, name, track count and image. Use before referencing a playlist.
name: get_playlists

description: Returns the tracks of a playlist (uri, name, artists, album, duration).
name: get_playlist_tracks

description: The user's saved (liked) tracks, paginated.
name: get_saved_tracks

description: The user's most played artists, with genres.
name: get_top_artists

description: The user's most played tracks.
name: get_top_tracks

description: Searches the Spotify catalog (track/artist/album/playlist). Resolves names to URIs. Use to find mentioned artists and tracks.
name: search_spotify

description: Artists related to an artist (Spotify's primary similarity).
name: get_related_artists

description: Artist data from the Spotify client: name, biography, followers, monthly listeners and image. Note: genres/popularity may come back empty — Spotify no longer exposes genres internally and the public Web API is rate limited. Use artist_info (Last.fm) for genres/tags and artist_info/web_search for extra biography context.
name: get_artist

description: Generates recommendations from seeds (artists/tracks/genres). Use to build candidates.
name: get_recommendations

description: Metadata of up to 50 artists at once (genres, popularity, image).
name: get_several_artists

description: Metadata of up to 50 tracks at once.
name: get_several_tracks

description: New releases from the catalog (browse/new-releases). Use for the release radar.
name: new_releases
